sources.title: Pi-Vis v0.5.9 README
sources.finding: The application bundles unmodified Pi, runs independent parallel sessions, optionally creates a Git worktree per session, and includes a diff viewer. Released installers target Apple Silicon macOS; Intel requires a source build. The browser dev renderer is a stub preview, not a separately released browser client.

sources.title: Pi-Vis official product documentation
sources.locator: Sections No second agent loop; No accounts, no server; Sessions in parallel; Install
sources.finding: The site explicitly describes a local GUI around the bundled Pi runtime, one Pi process per session, no app-vendor account/server, and Apple Silicon-only release downloads. It distinguishes Pi extensions/config from the GUI.

sources.title: Pi-Vis concrete Pi launch integration
sources.finding: Electron main forks a Pi-session host, which imports the pinned bundled Pi runtime and calls createAgentSessionServices, createAgentSessionFromServices and createAgentSessionRuntime. Pi is the actual coding harness. Model-provider labels are not additional coding agents.

sources.title: Pi-Vis bundled Pi dependency
sources.finding: The application version is0.5.9 and the bundled Pi coding-agent dependency is pinned to 1.4.0. The app README says it exclusively uses that bundled runtime.

sources.title: Pi-Vis provider-login implementation
sources.locator: bridge.mjs modelAccess login lines 55–68 and loginProvider handler2050–2089
sources.finding: The visible provider-auth path checks the live Pi provider and its OAuth/API-key login method, creates a product authentication interaction and calls Pi runtime login. Provider support is taken from the bundled runtime, not guessed from model names.

sources.title: Pi-Vis displayed source diff
sources.locator: Original site/assets/screenshots/diff.png, Changes pane for src/queue/consumer.ts
sources.finding: Opened exact pixels display removed Redis blpop/requeue lines and added backoffMs import, PROMOTE_BATCH, promoteDue function and delayed-queue source code. This is actual code content in the real renderer, not merely four-file counts. Vendor seeded sample data is disclosed separately.

sources.title: Pi-Vis application MIT grant
sources.locator: LICENSE, MIT License and permission grant
sources.finding: The main application repository is MIT licensed, free of charge. Bundled third-party runtime/theme notices have separate attribution and are not a separate hosted-service license.
